title: Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance ConfigBackup Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro InterScan Web Security Virtual Appliance. A low-privilege user can perform actions that should require extra privileges. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information under the context of root.
